title: An NYT reporter finds AI-generated, unauthorized biographies of herself and other journalists on Amazon, where AI-made books with elusive "authors" proliferate (Kashmir Hill/New York Times)
summary: Kashmir Hill / New York Times: An NYT reporter finds AI-generated, unauthorized biographies of herself and other journalists on Amazon, where AI-made books with elusive “authors” proliferate — Recently, I received a strange text from a new acquaintance. “You have your own biography???” it read.
contentText:
Kashmir Hill / New York Times :

An NYT reporter finds AI-generated, unauthorized biographies of herself and other journalists on Amazon, where AI-made books with elusive “authors” proliferate   —  Recently, I received a strange text from a new acquaintance.  “You have your own biography???” it read.
